svg.text: Pantry R35 — sanitized source excerpt
Drive connector screws (printed page 14)
Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
printed page 14
PRACTICE CARD: actual joint placement still conditional
printed page 14
01. Read the connector stamp and screw box. For this A34 candidate use SD9112 (#9 × 1½ in), with a
compatible ¼-in hex nut setter. SDWS structural wood screws are a different product and are not a
substitute through these connector holes.
04. Fill the required holes: A34 Table 5 has four screws in each leg. Inspect all eight heads and both
members.
Do not countersink, hammer the head down, bend a flange or enlarge a hole to clear drywall.
printed page 14
Other plate options are not interchangeable: the A35 bent stud-to-plate A2/C2/D configuration uses 6 + 6
SD9112 screws; A1/C1/E uses 3 + 6. Its wrapped flange/heads can conflict with drywall. Generic mending
plates and nail-only stud ties are not selected.
printed page 14
Sources: ESR-3096 Fig. 5 / Table 5; Simpson approved SD Connector applications. Keep the exact product
and driver manuals at the work area.
